title: Program Manager, Global Clients
description:

As a Program Manager you will manage programs for Fortune 1000, national accounts, and enterprise customers. This position will support functions at the customer service level for all Electronic Security project opportunities. National Accounts are typically multi-geography enterprises and require ongoing coordination across area boundaries representing $15-$50 million total annual potential service and sales revenue to Securitas Electronic Security.

  • Electronic Security Group to discuss future ESP growth and how we can assist and plan for future support
  • Review workload regularly to ensure team is right sized, plan resource requirements for future opportunities identified by the Account teams.
  • Directly contact / interface with customers when required.
  • Influence process excellence team to assist in delivery process development and revisions to meet current business environment.
  • Create strategy and update project best practices/ processes and support procedures/requirements.
  • Provide support in achieving account profitability goals
  • Provide support of Installation Managers and Directors efforts in customer service relationship management involving National Account customer base with prompt, efficient, effective, and quality customer service and installation support through multiple service branches and/or multiple service areas
  • Provide and assist Installation Managers and Directors in providing necessary reporting, problem resolution, action plans and resource attainment to resolve performance issues.
  • Forms and maintains databases where necessary of nationally provided commodities.
  • Monitor Performance and provide direction to ensure projects are on time, on budget and within scope unless out of scope issues identified.
  • Create and maintain reporting dashboard to client, and present project, service and initiative conditions, weekly and monthly as well as regular business reviews, Quarterly/Annually.
  • Interface and coordinate with Logistics as it relates to staging and / or kitting ESP orders for quality installation readiness regarding spoke orders.
  • Meet on a regular basis to develop project plan with customer, including schedule, specific responsibilities of each party, deliverables, terms of acceptance, etc.
  • Ensures that the project team is trained on policy, standards, and procedures and those they are practiced in everyday project activities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Electronic Security Integration Experience
  • 10 years Project Management experience in security integration or a related field
  • Proficiency with MS Outlook, Word, and Excel
  • Understanding of construction processes and project flows in construction
  • Past experience in delivering professional services such as consulting, system implementation, software support, network design or installation, etc.
  • Demonstrated record of team management skills
  • Successfully managed National Accounts
  • Excellent verbal and written customer communication skills.
  • Strong technical skills and understanding of technology such as software, networking, and systems development.
  • Very detailed and organized

Education/Experience:

  • HS Diploma/GED required.
  • College degree in business or related field preferred.
  • Previous experience and familiarity with standard concepts, practices, and procedures within purchasing field preferred.

Securitas Technology Offers Comprehensive Benefits Including

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity Coverage
  • Company Paid Short Term and Long-Term Disability
  • 401K with 60% Match up to 6% of salary

We are a nationwide provider of security solutions and an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. Our core values of Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness are proudly demonstrated daily by our employees to our customers and the communities we service.

title: Senior data engineer - big data technologies
description:
About the Role

Our client is seeking a skilled Senior Data Engineer to join their analytics division in Randburg. This role is vital in designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that support advanced analytics and business intelligence initiatives. You will work with large datasets and cutting-edge big data technologies to transform raw data into actionable insights. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced data professional to contribute to data-driven decision-making within a forward-thinking organization that values innovation and professional development.

Key Responsibilities Design, construct, install, test, and maintain highly scalable data management systems and pipelines. Develop and implement ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform, and load data from various sources into data warehouses and data lakes. Optimize data retrieval and processing for performance and cost-efficiency using big data technologies like Spark and Hadoop. Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions. Ensure data quality, integrity, and security across all data systems. Build and maintain data models that support reporting, analytics, and machine learning applications. Requirements Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. 5+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role. Proficiency in SQL and experience with relational and No SQL databases. Hands-on experience with big data technologies such as Apache Spark , Hadoop, Kafka, or similar. Strong programming skills in languages like Python or Scala. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and data warehousing solutions. Benefits Competitive salary and potential for annual bonuses. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits. Retirement savings plan with employer matching. Generous opportunities for training and professional development. A supportive hybrid work environment that promotes work-life balance.

title: Maintenance Helper
description:
POSITION: Full-Time, 80 hours per pay


PAY GRADE: $14.00 - $17.00 per hour


BENEFITS: Up to family coverage for health, dental, and vision insurance effective first of the month after date of hire (employee pays 15% of premium, county pays 85%). $1,500 yearly stipend if you do not need the county insurance. Life insurance coverage at no cost to employees. 5 Vacation days first year, 10 vacation days starting second year, 3 personal days per year, 10 sick days per year, 13 paid holidays off. Enrollment in Clarion County’s Pension plan (vested after 5 years, eligible to retire at 55 with 20 years of service).


QUALIFICATIONS: High School Diploma or GED and Valid PA Driver's License. Maintenance experience preferred.


GENERAL DEFINITION

Position performs unskilled and semi-skilled manual labor in the care and maintenance of the County buildings and grounds. Work generally is performed under immediate supervision, but routine tasks may be performed under only general supervision. To perform general maintenance and repairs duties within the buildings and grounds of County owned and leased property.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Performs routine cleaning of offices, restrooms, hallways, stairways, elevator and other areas within county building.
  • Trimming duties, trash removal and repair and maintenance of existing landscaped areas
  • Washes walls, ceilings, woodwork and windows.
  • Strips, waxes and polishes tile floors.
  • Empties wastebaskets and recycling bins. Takes trash and recyclables to disposal and collection areas. Shreds paper to be recycled.
  • Replenishes bathroom supplies.
  • Plants, trims, waters and fertilizes shrubs and flowers, and rakes leaves.
  • Picks up and disposes of litter and debris.
  • Performs minor and routine repairs, such as painting and unclogging plumbing.
  • Stocks department supplies.
  • Checks boiler, gauges and other equipment for proper operation and makes minor adjustments if necessary.
  • Checks buildings on a routine basis to ensure they are in good repair and well-maintained o provide a safe working environment for employees as well as the general public.
  • Transports materials to/from proper departments; clears loading dock area.
  • Changes light bulbs as needed.
  • Installs equipment as needed.
  • Removes snow manually from walkways and entrance ways or removes snow from other areas and/or cuts grass as required.
  • Makes repairs to damaged equipment.
  • Operates power equipment and hand tools to perform essential job duties.
  • Paints required fixtures, building and other objects as directed.
  • Performs other related duties as required.

OTHER DUTIES OF THE JOB

  1. Assists Supervisor with work assignments or special projects as necessary.
  2. Assists with setting up and cleaning for special events.
  3. Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  1. Works with average indoor and outdoor exposure to noise, stress and disruptions.
  2. Normal indoor exposure to dust/dirt; above normal when cleaning air ducts.
  3. Subject to working different shifts as required.
  4. Subject to periodically working in adverse conditions or various outdoor elements depending on nature of job assignment.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL CONDITIONS

  1. Must possess ability to record, convey and present information, explain procedures and follow instructions.
  2. Must be able to stand and walk intermittently for long periods throughout the workday, with occasional sitting, bending, twisting, stooping, climbing, carrying, pushing, pulling, reaching and grasping and driving as necessary to carry out duties of job.
  3. Dexterity requirements range from simple to coordinated movements of fingers/hands, feet/legs, torso as necessary to carry out job duties.
  4. Medium work with frequent lifting/carrying of objects weighing from 25 to 50 pounds; occasionally lifts 100-pound with assistance and/or lifting equipment.
  5. Must demonstrate emotional stability.
  6. Must be able to move frequently throughout the workday.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED

  1. Must be able to speak and understand the English language in an understandable manner in order to carry out essential job duties.
  2. Must possess ability to function independently, have flexibility and the ability to work effectively with clients, co-workers and others.
  3. Must possess a willingness to travel as needed.
  4. Must possess knowledge of the methods, tools and practices used in general maintenance and construction.
  5. Must possess knowledge and ability to detect defects in equipment and make proper adjustments.
  6. Must possess knowledge of the occupational hazards and safety precautions and the ability to exercise skill in the care and use of various tools and equipment.
  7. Must possess ability to utilize County vehicles and various equipment such as a snow blower, tractor, hand tools, drill press, etc.
  8. Must possess ability to follow oral and written instructions.
  9. Must possess ability to accurately and safely complete general repairs and maintenance on heating, air conditioning and plumbing needs.
  10. Must possess ability to operate County vehicles used for maintenance and to plow snow in winter and cut grass in spring and summer.
  11. Must have general knowledge of local codes and regulations and ability to troubleshoot problem areas.
  12. Must possess general knowledge regarding the operation of personal computers.

Physical Requirements:

This position operates in a typical office environment and requires the ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation. Physical requirements may include:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, handling documents, and using office equipment.
  • Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds as needed.
  • Clear verbal and written communication skills for effective interaction with colleagues and stakeholders.

Why Mercer

At Mercer, you’ll be part of a collaborative, people-first team where relationships matter and performance drives opportunity. We invest in training, value open communication, and support growth for individuals who are willing to learn, adapt, and take ownership of their success.

title: Postdoc: Spaceborne Retrieval of River Speed
description:
## **Job Details**

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

The Surface Water and Ocean Topography ( [SWOT](https://swot.jpl.nasa.gov/)) mission, launched in late 2022, has revolutionized the study of rivers and lakes from space. Its breakthroughs range from enabling the first global inventory of changes in surface water stores and fluxes to advancing our understanding of hydraulics in the world’s largest rivers. However, one key frontier remains underexplored: estimating cross-sectional average velocity along river networks and its relationship with flow wave propagation. Cross-sectional average velocity and wave speed are crucial for calculating river discharge, forecasting floods, understanding sediment dynamics, and modeling river channel migration, among others. Despite these vital applications, remote sensing-based techniques to retrieve the river velocity and wave speed have remained elusive, until now.

How can we use the vantage point of orbiting satellites to measure river velocity without the need for in situ information? How reliable is this retrieval of velocity? What other novel observations can be extracted from the SWOT data to enable new understanding of water propagation through the river network? Your mission - your opportunity - is to bring us closer to answering these questions! If you are driven to discover, invent, and encourage future generations, you are ready for JPL!

The NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL), managed by the California Institute of Technology (Caltech), invites applications for one postdoctoral position in river remote sensing, with emphasis on stream velocity from [SWOT](https://swot.jpl.nasa.gov/) wide-swath altimetry data. The selected candidate will be co-advised by JPL Scientists [Dr. Renato Frasson](https://science.jpl.nasa.gov/people/Frasson/) and [Dr. Cédric David](https://www.jpl.nasa.gov/site/research/cedavid/). Dr. David is a Principal Investigator member of the NASA [SWOT](https://swot.jpl.nasa.gov/) Science Team and of an [Earth Science to Action](https://science.nasa.gov/earth-science/earth-science-to-action/) pilot project; and Dr. Frasson is a Principal Investigator in the NASA’s Earth Action: Water Resources Program and a longstanding member of the SWOT Discharge Algorithm Working Group.

**Desired qualifications:**

- Ph.D. in geography, hydrology, civil engineering, environmental engineering, or a related field, earned recently or near completion.
- Proven proficiency using the SWOT datasets including the pixel cloud, raster, vector products at large scales, with strong preference given to candidates who have experience addressing novel problems beyond the scope of standard SWOT products.
- Demonstrated ability to develop innovative technical solutions that advance the state of the art in fluvial geomorphology or river hydraulics using satellite data, with a focus on solutions that scale across vast geographical regions.
- Direct experience reconciling satellite remote sensing observations with hydraulic models (e.g. the Hydrologic Engineering Center River Analysis System: HEC-RAS), or large-scale river routing models (e.g. NASA’s Routing Application for Programmed Integration of Discharge: RAPID).
- Proficiency in Python or other programming languages for scientific computing and spatial data analysis.
- Willingness to conduct stakeholder engagement, including soliciting and incorporating feedback in a flexible, dynamic project environment. Experience interacting with government agencies is a plus.
- Strong publication record demonstrating ability to conduct research independently and collaboratively.

JPL has a catalog of benefits and perks that span from the traditional to the unique. This includes a variety of health, dental, vision, wellbeing, and retirement plans, paid time off, learning, rideshare, childcare, flexible schedule, parental leave and many more. Our focus is on work-life balance, and living healthy, fulfilling lives as we Dare Mighty Things Together. For benefits eligible positions, benefits are effective the first day of the month coincident with or immediately following the employee’s start date.

For further benefits information click [Benefits and Perks](https://www.jpl.jobs/benefits-perks)

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

The Data Engineer will be responsible for expanding and optimizing the data and data pipeline architecture, as well as optimizing data flow and collection for cross functional teams. The Data Engineer is an experienced data pipeline builder and data wrangler who enjoys optimizing data systems and building them from the ground up. The Data Engineer will support software developers, database architects, data analysts and data scientists on data initiatives and will ensure optimal data delivery architecture is consistent throughout ongoing projects. They must be self‑directed and comfortable supporting the data needs of multiple teams, systems and products. The Data Engineer will be required to optimise or even re‑design the data architecture to support the next generation of products and data initiatives. The Data Engineer is also responsible for the maintenance, improvement, cleaning, and manipulation of data in the business’s operational and analytics databases in order to understand and aid in the implementation of database requirements, analyse performance, and troubleshoot any existent issues. The Data Engineer has to be an expert in SQL development further providing support to the Data and Analytics in database design, data flow and analysis activities. The position of the Data Engineer also plays a key role in the development and deployment of innovative big data platforms for advanced analytics and data processing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain optimal data pipeline architecture, assemble large, complex data sets that meet functional and non‑functional business requirements.
  • Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements: automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, re‑designing infrastructure for greater scalability.
  • Build the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources using SQL and 'big data' technologies.
  • Implement analytics tools that utilize the data pipeline to provide actionable insights into customer acquisition, operational efficiency and other key business performance metrics.
  • Work with stakeholders including the Executive, Product, Data and Design teams to assist with data‑related technical issues and support their data infrastructure needs.
  • Keep our data separated and secure across national boundaries through multiple data centres.
  • Implement data tools for analytics and data scientist team members that assist them in building and optimizing our product into an innovative industry leader.
  • Work with data and analytics experts to strive for greater functionality in our data systems.
  • Supports junior data engineering personnel by creating databases optimized for performance, implementing schema changes, and maintaining data architecture standards across all of the business’s databases.
  • The Data Engineer leads innovation through exploration, benchmarking, making recommendations, and implementing big data technologies for platforms.
  • Develop and implement scripts for database maintenance, monitoring, performance tuning, and so forth.
  • Designing and developing scalable ETL packages (Abinitio) from the business source systems and the development of ETL routines in order to populate databases from sources and also to create aggregates.
  • Oversee large-scale data Hadoop platforms and support the fast‑growing data within the business.
  • The Data Engineer is responsible for enabling and running data migrations across different databases and different servers, for example, data migration from SQL servers to Oracle.
  • Define and implement data stores based on system requirements and other requirements.
  • Perform thorough testing and validation in order to support the accuracy of data transformations and data verification used in machine learning models.
  • Ensure proper data governance and quality across the Data and Analytics department and the business as a whole.
  • The Data Engineer plays an analytical role where ad‑hoc analyses of data stored in the business’s databases is performed and writes SQL scripts, stored procedures, functions, and views.
  • Troubleshoot data issues within the business and across the business and presents solutions to these issues.
  • Proactively analyse and evaluate the business’s databases in order to identify and recommend improvements and optimisation.
  • Analyse complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships in order to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models.
  • Develop and implement scripts for database maintenance, monitoring, and performance tuning to be applied across the business.
  • The Data Engineer also plays a supporting role to the data warehousing department in the implementation of the data warehouse for the new big data platforms.
  • He/She works collaboratively with the entire Data and Analytics team, providing support to the entire department for its data‑centric needs.
  • Keep up with industry trends and best practices, advising management on new and improved data engineering strategies that will drive departmental performance leading to improvement in overall data governance across the business, and promoting informed decision‑making, ultimately improving overall business performance.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced working SQL knowledge and experience working with relational databases, query authoring (SQL) as well as working familiarity with a variety of databases.
  • Experience building and optimizing 'big data' data pipelines, architectures and data sets.
  • Experience performing root cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer specific business questions and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Strong analytic skills related to working with unstructured datasets.
  • Build processes supporting data transformation, data structures, metadata, dependency and workload management.
  • A successful history of manipulating, processing and extracting value from large, disconnected datasets.
  • Working knowledge of message queuing, stream processing, and highly scalable 'big data' data stores.
  • Strong project management and organisational skills.
  • Experience supporting and working with cross‑functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Experience and Related Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in a Data Engineer role.
  • Graduate degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Informatics, Information Systems or another quantitative field.
  • Experience with big data tools: Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, etc.
  • Experience with relational SQL and NoSQL databases, including Postgres and Cassandra.
  • Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools: Azkaban, Luigi, Airflow, etc.
  • Experience with AWS cloud services: EC2, EMR, RDS, Redshift, Abinitio.
  • Experience with stream‑processing systems: Storm, Spark‑Streaming, etc.
  • Experience with object‑oriented/object function scripting languages: Python, Java, C++, Scala, etc.
  • Experience working with large and complex data sets and analysing volumes of data through basic Microsoft Excel functions, for example, macros and pivot tables.
  • Experience working in internet technologies, for example, SaaS, IaaS, and PaaS.
  • Experience in the creation and debugging of databases critical to the business’s mission.
  • Strong working and conceptual knowledge of building and maintaining physical and logical data models and experience with Tableau, Domo or other business intelligence tools.
  • Experience with monitoring, disaster recovery, backup, automated testing, automated schema migration, and continuous deployment.

Communication Skills

Communication skills for the Data Engineer are non‑negotiable. Communication skills will be needed in his role where he has to convey messages and instructions clearly to the supporting personnel in order to ensure efficient execution of duties within the junior department.

Technological Savvy / Analytical Skills

The Data Engineer must also have exceptional analytical skills, showing fluency in the use of tools such as MySQL and strong Python, Shell, Java, PHP, and T‑SQL programming skills. He/She must also be technologically adept, demonstrating strong computer skills. The candidate must additionally be capable of developing databases using SSIS packages, T‑SQL, MSSQL, and MySQL scripts. The candidate will also have an ability to design, build, and maintain the business’s ETL pipeline and data warehouse. The candidate will also demonstrate expertise in data modelling and query performance tuning on SQL Server, MySQL, Abinitio, Redshift, Postgres or similar platforms.

Interpersonal Skills

A candidate for the position must also possess certain personal attributes that make him more suited for the position. The candidate must be result‑driven, be an analytical and creative thinker, be an innovative problem solver, be self‑motivated and proactive, be highly organised, have ability to handle‑multiple and simultaneous tasks meeting aggressive deadlines, be a team player, and demonstrate an exceptional ability to stay calm and composed in the face of adversity.

Business Skills

  • Depth in data modelling and database design: This is the core skill of the data architect. The effective data architect is sound across all phases of data modelling, from conceptualisation to database optimisation. In his experience this skill extends to SQL development and perhaps database administration.
  • Breadth in established and emerging data technologies: In addition to depth in established data management and reporting technologies, the data architect is either experienced or conversant in emerging tools like columnar and NoSQL databases, predictive analytics, data visualisation, and unstructured data.
  • Ability to conceive and portray the bigger data picture: When the data architect initiates, evaluates, and influences projects they do so from the perspective of the entire organisation and with focus on their area. The data architect maps the systems and interfaces used to manage data, sets standards for data management, analyses current state and conceives desired future state, and conceives projects needed to close the gap between current state and future goals.
  • Analytical Problem‑Solving: Approaching high‑level data challenges with a clear eye on what is important; employing the right approach/methods to make the maximum use of time and human resources.
  • Creative Problem‑Solving: Approaching data organisation challenges with a clear eye on what is important; employing the right approach/methods to make the maximum use of time and human resources.

Industry Knowledge

Understanding the way our banking industry functions and how data can be collected, analysed and utilised; maintaining flexibility in the face of large data developments.

Qualifications

  • The Data Engineer must have a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or any other technology related field.
  • An equivalent of the same in working experience is also accepted for the position.
  • 5 years of experience in managing financial services data, especially as a data architect.
  • Advanced data analysis skills using Excel, Abinitio, SQL and reporting tools to import, analyse and report on data.
  • Relative certifications.

Important Closing Date

Take note that applications will not be accepted on the below date and onwards, kindly submit applications ahead of the closing date indicated below. 21/10/26

All appointments will be made in line with FirstRand Group’s Employment Equity plan. The Bank supports the recruitment and advancement of individuals with disabilities. In order for us to fulfil this purpose, candidates can disclose their disability information on a voluntary basis. The Bank will keep this information confidential unless we are required by law to disclose this information to other parties.

Should you have any queries, please log it via MyQ.

Company Overview

FirstRand provides a comprehensive range of financial services in South Africa and certain markets in broader Africa. The group also offers certain niche products and services in the UK and India. Listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) and the Namibian Stock Exchange (NSX), FirstRand Limited is the largest financial institution by market capitalisation in Africa. The group follows a multi‑branding approach. Its portfolio of financial services businesses includes FNB, RMB, WesBank, Ashburton Investments, Aldermore, MotoNovo and DirectAxis. Many are leaders in their respective segments and markets, offering transactional, lending, investment and insurance products and services. The FirstRand Corporate Centre houses many of the critical functions required by a large and complex financial services group. The group’s track record of delivering superior returns to shareholders has been achieved through a combination of organic growth, acquisitions, innovation and the creation of completely new businesses. The group’s purpose of delivering Shared Prosperity provides many opportunities for employees to innovate to address social and environmental challenges in our markets. All of our businesses have successful Volunteering programmes which also allow employees to adopt and support causes close to their hearts.

title: Senior Intellectual Property Counsel
description:
About Us

At Technip Energies, we are more than just a leading engineering and technology company — we are pioneers committed to shaping a sustainable future. With thousands of talented professionals worldwide, we deliver innovative solutions to real-world energy challenges while fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment.

Join us on a one-of-a-kind journey where you can take pride in being part of the solution for the benefit of our planet, people, and communities.

Position Summary

The Senior Intellectual Property Counsel is a senior, hands-on attorney within the Global Intellectual Property team, advising a global engineering and technology business on complex intellectual property matters. The position serves as a trusted legal advisor to business, technology, engineering, and commercial stakeholders throughout the intellectual property lifecycle.

This role independently leads substantive patent prosecution and IP legal counseling, evaluates freedom-to-operate and infringement risk, advises on IP-related transactions and collaborations, and supports disputes and governance. The successful candidate provides technically informed, commercially practical legal advice and oversees outside counsel while retaining accountability for legal strategy and outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Patent Strategy, Procurement & Prosecution

  • Independently manage patentability assessments, patent drafting and preparation, claim strategy, office action responses, and prosecution decisions.
  • Advise on patent filing scope, jurisdictional considerations, alternative protection strategies, and alignment with technology and business objectives.
  • Partner with IP Asset Managers, inventors, and technology leaders to develop effective patent protection strategies.
  • Direct and oversee outside patent counsel while retaining substantive accountability for legal quality, strategy, and outcomes.

IP Legal Counseling & Risk Management

  • Provide independent legal advice concerning patents, trade secrets, confidential information, ownership, enforceability, and third-party intellectual property rights.
  • Lead legal freedom-to-operate and commercial-clearance assessments, including infringement analysis and practical risk-mitigation recommendations.
  • Identify and assess material IP risks, develop defensible legal conclusions, and recommend commercially appropriate courses of action.
  • Advise on safeguarding company confidential information and the receipt, handling, and use of third-party information.

IP Transactions, Diligence & Technology Collaborations

  • Advise on IP provisions in commercial, procurement, technology, and operational agreements.
  • Counsel stakeholders on IP ownership, licensing, confidentiality, permitted use rights, and allocation of IP risks.
  • Lead IP legal diligence in acquisitions, partnerships, and strategic transactions.
  • Structure and negotiate IP arrangements in joint development, technology collaborations, and strategic engagements.
  • Coordinate with commercial counsel and business leaders to align IP positions with commercial objectives and corporate risk tolerance.

Disputes, Governance & Strategic Support

  • Advise on potential infringement, IP disputes, enforcement strategy, and dispute resolution; coordinate with outside counsel as appropriate.
  • Support development and implementation of IP policies, governance frameworks, and legal risk-management practices.
  • Provide practical IP training and guidance to legal, technical, and business stakeholders.
  • Improve IP legal processes and cross-functional collaboration.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering from an accredited institution.
  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school.
  • Active registration as a Patent Attorney before the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO).
  • Active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.
  • At least ten (10) years of substantive IP legal experience, including significant patent preparation and prosecution responsibilities and progressively complex IP counseling.
  • Professional maturity and independent legal capability comparable to an experienced partner-track senior associate or partner-eligible attorney in a reputable IP law firm.
  • Substantial experience drafting and prosecuting patents involving chemical, mechanical, and related technologies, including claim development and prosecution strategy.
  • Demonstrated experience with IP contracts, ownership, licensing, confidentiality, freedom-to-operate, and infringement risk.
  • Ability to independently analyze sophisticated legal issues, reach defensible conclusions, and deliver practical business-oriented advice.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Significant foundational experience in a reputable IP law firm, preferably followed by in-house legal experience.
  • Experience supporting global industrial, engineering, energy, process technology, or other technology-intensive businesses.
  • Familiarity with chemical, process, industrial equipment, or multidisciplinary technologies.
  • International patent portfolio management and coordination with foreign counsel.
  • Experience in technology development agreements, strategic collaborations, licensing, M&A diligence, or complex IP disputes.
  • Experience advising senior business and technology leaders on IP strategy and risk.

Role Specific Knowledge & Skills

  • Independent legal judgment, professional accountability, and ownership of matters through resolution.
  • Ability to balance legal risk, commercial objectives, technical considerations, and business decisions.
  • Strong relationships and communication with inventors, engineers, commercial teams, legal colleagues, and senior leadership.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, statutory deadlines, and business-critical legal work while escalating material risks appropriately.
  • Excellent written and verbal legal communication, sound ethics, discretion, and protection of confidential information.

Additional Information

  • Location, reporting relationship, and employment sponsorship policy were not provided in the source JD and should be confirmed before posting.
  • U.S. citizenship is not specified as a requirement in the source JD; any proposed restriction should be reviewed with HR and Legal before publication.

description:

We’ll reward all your hard work with competitive salary and benefits.
Join us and you’ll become part of the global IHG family – and like all families, all our individual team members share some winning characteristics. You need to show us you care: that you notice the little things that make a difference to guests as well as always looking for ways to improve - visit www.careers.ihg.com to find out more about us.

title: (1710) data engineer - bstd
description:
Job Description

The main purpose of this position is to build, maintain and optimise business intelligence (BI) data pipelines that feed from various data systems across the South African Reserve Bank (SARB) and enable the support of Data as a Service (Daa S) to the SARB.

Responsibilities Implement data service standards and frameworks across the SARB to ensure optimised solutions and adherence to best practice, that is, data operations, development and operations as well as machine learning and operations. Take responsibility for BI data pipelines and flows for domain specific analytic implementations across the SARB. Ensure understanding of client’s data requirements in order to drive continuous development of data services and address evolving business needs. Design and build data pipelines that are robust, modular, scalable, deployable, reproducible and versioned for analytics and reporting purposes. Continually monitor and optimise domain specific data pipelines to ensure data availability and optimal long-term performance of data pipelines. Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes. Maintain SLA adherence for data availability and incident resolution. Support releases, deployments and environment stability. Ensure compliance with SARB Data governance frameworks, Security standards as well as Audit and regulatory requirements. Implement new data engineering features. Implement data sharing technology services for the SARB, in alignment with the BI and Business Solutions and Technology Department (BSTD) Strategy. Implement ingestion from structured, semi-structured and external data sources. Diagnose, manage and enhance the performance of BI data marts and warehouses across the SARB by applying data engineering techniques such as distributed computing and data optimisation. Resolve data issues across BI data marts, data warehouses and data lakes. Implement initiatives to ensure compliance and adherence to security and application standards with respect to all BI data services. Identify and manage the mitigation of risks relating to domain-specific BI data services. Proactively engage and problem-solve with cross functional stakeholders – from technical data teams to managers – to address their data needs in order to build impactful analytics solutions. Provide reporting and recommendations on data service performance, improvements and data availability for domain-specific solutions to management. Keep abreast of industry best practices and technologies and lead implementation thereof to optimise effective and efficient data pipelines and services. Impart knowledge of the technical environment to other data engineers, systems development, database administrator, infrastructure and enterprise architecture and enterprise information management teams. Qualifications

To be considered for this position, candidates must be in possession of:

A Bachelor’s degree (NQF 7) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Management, Technology or an equivalent qualification. Five to eight years’ experience in building, maintaining and optimising data pipelines and services.

Additional requirements include:

Ability to write clean, maintainable, scalable and robust code in object-oriented language, e.g., Python, Scala, Java, in a professional setting. Proven experience building data pipelines in production for advanced analytics use cases. Experience working across structured, semi-structured and unstructured data. Experience with database technologies such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle Database, My SQL, Postgre SQL, IBM Db2 and No SQL. Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Dask), cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, containerization) and analytics libraries (e.g., pandas, Num Py, matplotlib). Familiarity with time-series and graph database types and related technologies (Druid, Influx DB, Neo4 J, etc.) would be considered a plus. Practical knowledge of software engineering concepts and best practices, including Dev Ops/Data/Ops practices, Development Security and Operations and Data Operations, would be considered a plus. Ability to scope projects, define workstreams and lead, and mentor more junior colleagues. Continuous improvement knowledge and skill. Industry, organisational and business awareness, knowledge and skill. Data governance, compliance and quality assurance knowledge and skill. Business continuity planning knowledge and skill. Information technology (IT) enablement planning knowledge and skill. IT transformation and innovation knowledge skills. Release management knowledge and skill. Infrastructure design and development knowledge and skill. Workload estimation knowledge and skill. Technical analysis knowledge and skill. Systems integration knowledge and skill. IT governance knowledge and skill. Continued learning and/or professional development knowledge and skill.

In line with the SARB’s commitment to diversifying its workforce, preference will be given to suitable candidates from designated groups. People with disabilities are welcome to apply.

The SARB offers remuneration and benefits commensurate with the level of the position and in line with the market. The level at which the successful applicant will be appointed will depend on his/her competence and experience. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer
description:
The Role

We are looking for an Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer to join our Cloud Platform Engineering Team.

In this role, you will own cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, and system reliability, with a strong focus on cloud-agnostic portability, Kubernetes administration, Infrastructure as Code, and automated CI/CD workflows.

We are looking for someone with strong hands-on experience in Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, multi-cloud environments, and IAM solutions such as Keycloak.

Responsibilities

Kubernetes Administration

Deploy, manage, scale, and troubleshoot workloads on Kubernetes, initially using Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), with Helm and Kustomize.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Build modular and cloud-agnostic infrastructure using Terraform, enabling consistent deployments across GCP, other public clouds, and on-premise environments.

  • CI/CD Pipeline Ownership: Design, maintain, and optimize reusable GitHub Actions workflows for automated testing, containerization, and deployment.

  • Manage container images and deployment workflows using GitHub Container Registry (GHCR).

  • IAM & Platform Deployment: Deploy, operate, and scale highly available Keycloak clusters.

  • Configure GitHub Workload Identity Federation (OIDC) to provide GitHub Actions with secure, keyless access to GCP resources.

  • Implement and maintain secure secrets management practices.

  • Collaborate with technical leadership to evaluate and improve deployment strategies, including traditional CI/CD and GitOps approaches using tools such as ArgoCD or Flux.

  • Contribute to the reliability, scalability, security, and portability of the overall cloud platform.

Requirements

Advanced hands-on experience managing production Kubernetes environments, including container networking.

  • Strong proficiency with Terraform, Helm, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) methodologies.

  • Deep experience designing and maintaining deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions.

  • Experience working with GitHub Container Registry (GHCR).

  • Experience deploying and maintaining production Keycloak/IAM environments.

  • Strong understanding of OIDC, identity management, authentication, and authorization concepts.

  • Experience with secrets management and cloud security best practices.

  • Experience working with GCP/GKE and an understanding of multi-cloud or cloud-agnostic infrastructure approaches.

  • Strong understanding of containerized environments, deployment automation, and system reliability

Core Tech Stack

Kubernetes (GKE) | Terraform | Helm | Kustomize | GitHub Actions | GHCR | GCP | Multi-Cloud | Keycloak | OIDC | IaC | ArgoCD / Flux

title: Slitter Operator (3rd Shift)
description:
Slitter Operator – Warehouse & Finishing (We'll Train You!)

3rd Shift (11PM–7AM) | Full-Time | Competitive Pay + Overtime Opportunities

Build Something You Can Hold in Your Hands

At Sheridan Lebanon Junction, we're passionate about bringing books and publications to life through high-quality printing and finishing. Our talented teams turn ideas into finished products people can hold, read, and enjoy.

If you're looking for a stable, hands-on career with paid training and opportunities to advance, we'd love to have you join our Warehouse & Production team as a Slitter Operator.

What You'll Do

As a Slitter Operator, you'll be responsible for the safe and efficient operation, setup, and routine maintenance of slitting and rewinding equipment used in the production of printed paper products. You will convert large paper rolls into narrower rolls according to job specifications by:

  • Safely operating slitting and rewinding equipment according to job specifications, production schedules, and established operating procedures.
  • Reviewing job tickets, production specifications, and samples to ensure the correct product is being produced.
  • Performing complete machine setups, including positioning knives, shafts, cores, guides, tension controls, and other machine components.
  • Performing knife and anvil changes and properly adjusting equipment for each job.
  • Setting and maintaining proper web tension, alignment, tracking, and winding conditions.
  • Monitoring equipment throughout the production run, conducting quality inspections, and making adjustments to maintain product quality and efficiency.
  • Performing roll changes and safely loading, unloading, and positioning rolls on the equipment.
  • Verifying roll width, diameter, winding, edge condition, splice quality, and other applicable specifications.
  • Accurately splicing paper to minimize production interruptions and material waste.
  • Identifying and correcting slab damage, wrinkles, telescoping, loose winding, damaged edges, and other roll defects.
  • Sanding roll edges as necessary to meet quality requirements.
  • Performing daily machine inspections, routine cleaning, lubrication, blade/anvil changes, and preventative maintenance.
  • Troubleshooting equipment problems and performing minor mechanical repairs within operator scope.
  • Safely operating a forklift and clamp truck to transport, position, load, and unload paper rolls up to 6,000 pounds.
  • Following all safety policies, wearing required PPE, utilizing machine guards/lockout-tagout, and participating in Peer-to-Peer Safety Audits.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has previous manufacturing or production experience.
  • Possesses strong mechanical aptitude with the ability to perform setup, routine maintenance, blade changes, and minor mechanical troubleshooting.
  • Can read and understand job tickets, production specifications, work instructions, and safety procedures.
  • Has basic math skills and the ability to accurately perform measurements and calculations.
  • Is able to safely operate a forklift and clamp truck (training provided).
  • Demonstrates strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work.
  • Works well independently as well as in a fast-paced team environment.
  • Can communicate effectively with supervisors, coworkers, maintenance, and quality departments.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Previous experience operating a slitter/rewinder.
  • Experience in paper converting, printing, or manufacturing environments.
  • Prior experience operating forklifts, clamp trucks, or handling large roll-stock materials.
  • Previous experience with machine setups or mechanical maintenance.

Physical Requirements

This is an active, hands-on manufacturing role that includes:

  • Standing and walking on concrete floors for extended periods during the shift.
  • Frequently bending, stooping, reaching, twisting, and climbing as required.
  • Safely lifting, handling, and positioning shafts weighing up to 50 pounds at waist height.
  • Operating powered industrial trucks (forklifts/clamp trucks) handling rolls weighing up to 6,000 pounds.
  • Working safely around moving machinery, rotating equipment, knives, shafts, and pinch points.
  • Working in a fast-paced environment with elevated noise levels.
  • Constant use of required personal protective equipment (PPE), including hearing protection and safety-toe footwear.

Why Join Sheridan?

We invest in our employees and create opportunities to build long-term careers. We offer:

  • Stable, full-time employment with a growing company.
  • A safe, values-based workplace built on integrity and respect.
  • Paid, hands-on training through Sheridan Academy.
  • Career advancement opportunities.
  • Tuition reimbursement for approved coursework.
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • A 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and paid holidays.
  • Company-paid basic life, AD&D, and short-term disability insurance.
  • First Stop Health telemedicine services at little to no cost.
  • A free and confidential Employee Assistance Program for wellness and mental health support.

title: Flight Telecom Systems Engineer II
description:
## **Job Details**

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

The **JPL Communications and Instruments Division** performs scientific investigations, advanced technology research, engineering developments and system implementations encompassing space telecommunications, tracking and active remote sensing using electromagnetic waves.

The **Flight Communications and Tracking Section** provides cost-effective space communications systems, software defined radios, high power RF amplifiers, and power supplies that support primary telecom subsystems and major radar and radiometer science payloads. The section also provides Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) flight equipment, radiometric science instruments, high stability frequency standards and clocks and seismometers for NASA/JPL missions. In addition to flight hardware expertise, the section specializes in collection of and processing of worldwide, fixed site, GNSS data that is processed into clock, atmospheric, and ionospheric GNSS correction metrics.  The section also develops high stability frequency references and clocks for flight and ground applications.

The Flight Communications & Tracking Section at JPL is looking for a highly motivated and experienced **Flight Telecom Systems Engineer II** to join their Communication System Engineering and Operations Group. As a member of this Group, you will have an opportunity to be involved in all phases of product development from early concept and mission formulation, low technology readiness specification and prototyping to engineering and flight model development and implementation, functional and environmental testing, and flight operations support. In this role, you will perform complex and varied engineering tasks within the telecom discipline, partnering with senior engineers across all phases of the product lifecycle.

**Tasks include but are not limited to:**

- Provide telecom system engineering support on various flight telecom subsystems for deep-space interplanetary missions, Earth-orbiting missions, and lunar/Mars relay networks.
- Demonstrate the collaborative, team-oriented approach expected of a future technical leader by proactively supporting teammates, sharing knowledge, and contributing to a positive, safety-conscious team culture.
- Take ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables, communicating progress, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior engineers and task leads.
- Build strong working relationships across the telecom team and with other subsystem engineers, laying the groundwork for future technical leadership roles.
- Participate actively in technical reviews and team discussions, offering sound engineering judgment and contributing to decisions that build trust with senior staff.
- Generate telecom component and subsystem-level requirements, responding to project and flight system needs with appropriate requirements flow down
- Develop and prepare interface agreements between the telecom subsystem and other spacecraft subsystems.
- Conduct system-level link analyses, using statistically-derived link parameters
- Partner with other engineers to evaluate current telecom components, algorithms, subsystems, and end-to-end system performance.
- Conduct software simulations and hardware tests, summarizing results to verify telecom system functionality.
- Contribute new ideas and concepts toward the improvement of existing telecom products and technologies.
- Present analyses and technical results at peer-level design and technical reviews.
- Contribute technical content, data, and graphics to proposal and Concept Study Report (CSR) development efforts.
- Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on concept development teams, applying telecom-specific expertise to devise, validate, and benchmark new approaches to technical challenges.
- Support the tracking and documentation of mass, power, and data volume specifications and allocations for assigned telecom components, under the guidance of senior engineers.
- Perform and/or provide independent review of reliability analyses (worst-case, parts stress, radiation, thermal, structural, etc.) and interface failure mode analysis.
- Draft or update telecom functional description documents, comm behavior manager documents, and other design control documents related to the telecom subsystem such as Interface Control Documents, Requirements Documents, Test Report Documents, Design Description Documents, etc.
- Create detailed test plans, procedures, and reports aligned with V&V objectives
- Support development of verification and validation (V&V) plans under the guidance of senior engineers, helping ensure compliance with system requirements
- Support key spacecraft-level Assembly, Test, and Launch Operations (ATLO) tests such as subsystem functional test, ground-station compatibility testing (with the Deep Space Network, Near Space Network, or other commercial providers), and environmental testing.
- Collaborate with ground station providers including the Deep Space Network (DSN), Near Space Network (NSN), European Space Tracking Network (ESTRACK), and commercial providers (eg KSAT).
- Support mission and concept proposal teams by providing subject matter expertise on telecom subsystem design and formal proposal writing/reviewing
- Provide telecom support to JPL’s concurrent engineering team for rapid design, analysis, and cost of mission concepts (Team X)
- Support preparation and documentation of Engineering Change Requests (ECRs) and waivers, coordinating Change Control Board (CCB) review with guidance from senior engineers.
- Support Hardware Review/Certification Requirements (HRCR) and Certificate of Flight Readiness (CoFR) reviews for flight deliveries of telecom subsystems
- Support the product manager in managing risks, performance error budgets, trade studies, design integration, and maintaining delivery schedules.
- Serve as a telecom operations engineer supporting flight missions in real time, monitoring telecom subsystem health, performance, and link status across all mission phases (launch, cruise, critical events, and extended operations).
- Support DSN, NSN, and commercial ground station pass planning and execution, including command verification, telemetry acquisition, and link performance assessment against pre-pass predicts.
- Participate in shift-based mission operations coverage, performing real-time and post-pass assessment of telecom subsystem telemetry and flagging off-nominal performance for follow-up.
- Support anomaly response activities for the telecom subsystem, performing root-cause analysis and recommending corrective actions in coordination with the flight team.
- Develop and maintain telecom operations products, including flight rules, standard operating procedures, contingency and anomaly response procedures, and operations handbooks.
- Design, develop, and implement software tools (e.g., Python, Jupyter, MATLAB) to automate telemetry trending, limit-checking, and anomaly detection for telecom subsystem performance.
- Build and maintain dashboards and analysis tools that compare downlink/uplink telemetry against link budget predicts and performance models, flagging deviations for engineering follow-up.
- Capture lessons learned from flight operations experience and incorporate them into updated operations procedures, tools, and training materials for future missions.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Hardware Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Physics or Mathematics with a minimum of 3 years of work related experience, or Master’s degree in a similar technical discipline with a minimum of 1 year of work related experience, or Ph.D in a similar technical discipline with a minimum of 0 years of work related experience.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across a technical team and build trust with peers and senior engineers.
- Demonstrated initiative and ownership mentality, with a track record of following through on assigned responsibilities with minimal oversight.
- Emerging leadership qualities — such as informally mentoring peers or interns, taking initiative on team tasks, or offering to help onboard others — with a clear desire to grow into a formal technical leadership role over time.
- Demonstrated sound judgment and reliability, as evidenced by an increasing scope of responsibility in prior roles or academic/research work.
- Eagerness to learn, receive feedback, and develop professionally in a fast-paced, team-oriented engineering environment.
- Ability to work independently on assigned tasks under general guidance, exercising sound judgment to select appropriate methods and approaches, and escalating significant risks or roadblocks to senior engineers.
- Ability to analyze complex technical factors and apply engineering judgment to resolve significant problems within assigned scope.
- Demonstrated creativity and innovative thinking in addressing important technical issues.
- Ability to collaborate successfully with other groups, sections, divisions, and organizations, both inside and outside JPL.
- Flexibility to react to frequent changes in plans and excel in a rapid-pace concurrent engineering environment.
- Proven experience designing, implementing, and testing electronic hardware for complex spaceflight systems.
- Proficiency in Python, Jupyter Notebook, and MATLAB for system analysis and automation
- Strong background in RF systems, Software-Defined Radios, digital and analog hardware design, and embedded software/firmware.
- Hands-on experience with RF test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, noise figure meters, bit error rate testers.
- Hands-on experience in testing of systems, including test planning, test procedure development, and data analysis, as well demonstrated ability to understand and debug/troubleshoot complex systems.
- Experience within a multidisciplinary system engineering (telecom systems, radar systems, spacecraft systems, avionics systems) or test team (electrical integration, spacecraft assembly electrical, spacecraft functional or telecom compatibility).
- Experience designing telecom subsystems for space applications, managing the link budget and reducing link uncertainties.
- Demonstrated knowledge of processes that are used to verify/validate the design requirements of systems.
- Ability to support domestic and international travel for testing and mission support.

**Preferred Skills:**

- Knowledge of Laboratory policies and procedures, NASA policies and procedures, and government regulations across a range of applications.
- Direct experience with flight telecom component development and delivery.
- Understanding of advanced principles, theories, concepts, and techniques in telecommunications including modulation and coding types, hardware including antennas and front-end RF hardware, link design and modeling, networking hardware and protocols, radio testing and test automation.
- Experience with Spacecraft, Planet, Instrument, C-matrix, and Events (SPICE) kernels and toolkit for spacecraft trajectory modeling in support of telecom link analysis
- Proficiency with a range of tools for numerical analysis, electronic design, firmware, embedded software, and/or testing automation.
- Familiarity with requirement tracking and management systems such as Jama.
- Experience in cost estimation for spacecraft components and subsystems
- Familiarity with ground station providers and services including the Deep Space Network (DSN), Near Space Network (NSN), European Space Tracking Network (ESTRACK), and commercial providers (eg KSAT).
- Experience with spectral mask regulations and measurement techniques.
- Experience with multipath and ray tracing analyses for base station rover communication links.
- Experience with development, documentation and execution of radio system tests, including formal validation and verification tracking for fulfillment of requirements.
- Experience designing and testing Software Defined Radios (SDR)

We believe that great member experiences begin with great employees. That's why we invest in our team through ongoing training, career development, leadership support, and opportunities for advancement.

At North Star, you're not just building a career—you're helping people build brighter financial futures.

Compliance & Operations

What We're Looking For

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Working at Walker

Our team of more than 1200 people work in environmental waste management and recovery, renewable energy, paving and construction, aggregates, and emulsions chemistries. We are a fifth-generation, family-owned company founded in 1887, operating from our base in the Niagara Region with facilities across Canada and the United States. We care about the environment, each other, and our neighbours, and give back to our communities. Join us on our journey to build a sustainable future, together.

About the Job

Reporting directly to the Director of Innovation and Product Development, you support Research and Development (R&D) and Business Development (BD) initiatives related to the development, manufacture and application of coatings. The Senior Innovation Chemist is responsible for leading R&D projects focused on the development of coating products, supporting the product development life cycle from strategic opportunity evaluation through R&D, scale up, and trials to commercialization. It is expected that this role will provide technical leadership, including mentoring and developing a lab team focused on coating development as well as providing support to Product Development, Quality Control/Quality Assurance, Operations, Business Development and Technical Service. You will bring advanced knowledge of coating chemistry, coating formulating, and coating manufacturing.

The salary range for this position is $100-$110K per year, based on qualifications and experience.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Leads R&D projects focused on product development for coatings; including establishing priorities, defining project scope, planning resources, monitoring timelines, reviewing technical data, and reporting. Ensuring progress towards strategic and commercialization objectives.

  • Maintains an active presence in the laboratory to support active projects and transfer knowledge to the rest of the team. Including supervision of direct report(s) and mentorship for indirect reports.
  • Leverages and applies knowledge of coating chemistry, formulation science, raw materials, manufacturing processes, and end-use applications to develop new products and improve existing formulations.

  • Oversees and supports scale-up and production transfer of new coating formulations by partnering with Operations to establish production procedures, quality control specifications, quality plans, and troubleshooting protocols.

  • Ensures coating products are developed with consideration for manufacturability, product performance, quality requirements, cost effectiveness, regulatory expectations, and customer needs.

  • Attends customer trials and makes customer visits as required; provides technical support to Sales on existing coating products and Business Development on new coating opportunities.

  • Supports Quality on customer complaints and Operations on production issues.

  • Involvement with coating industry through associations and conferences to ensure a close connection with the development of new coating chemistries, additives, applications, and regulations.

  • Displays outstanding Health and Safety awareness in the laboratory, production, and on construction sites.

Here’s What You Need

  • M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Chemistry an asset, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Materials Science, or Coatings Science.
  • Advanced technical knowledge of coating formulation, product development, manufacturing scale-up, and commercialization in a chemical or formulated products environment.

  • Minimum of five years (5) of relevant experience in R&D, product development, or technical leadership for the development of coatings products. Previous supervisory or technical leadership experience is considered an asset.

  • Valid G Class Ontario Driver’s Licence

  • Work is generally performed in a lab/ plant environment.

  • Required to travel to various production and/or customer sites during the course of the working day to consult, advise and oversee. Overnight travel will be necessary and will require a valid passport required for travel outside of Canada.

What’s in it for you

  • You become part of a team you can count on

  • A comprehensive total rewards package and benefits to support your wellbeing

L3Harris Aeromet is seeking an experienced Information System Security Officer (ISSO) to support classified systems operating in Special Access Program (SAP) environments. This role is responsible for maintaining the security posture and compliance of systems within SAP-accredited environments, supporting day-to-day cybersecurity operations, and helping sustain Authorization to Operate (ATO) status. - **Must have active Secret Clearance and able to obtain Top Secret/SCI.**
- Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 6 years of prior relevant experience.
- Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience.
- In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.

Preferred Additional Skills:

- Active CompTIA Security+ CE or obtain 8410 Intermediate (formerly IAT Level II 8570).
- Previous experience as an ISSO/ISSM (or equivalent position) overseeing cybersecurity on classified and/or unclassified systems under ICD503, NISPOM, NIST 800-53, JSIG and/or DoDM/D.
- Familiar with vulnerability and configuration management tools (ACAS, Nessus, SCC, STIG, Trellix, and DLP).
- Experience in creating, conducting, or overseeing internal security assessments.
- Experience with Linux based operating systems.
- Familiarity with COMSEC and TEMPEST.
- Experience in SAPF/SCIF environments.

Position:

The City of Sharonville is actively recruiting for a part-time Security Assistant to support operations at the Sharonville Convention Center. Under the direction of the Security Supervisor, the Security Assistant plays a key role in ensuring a safe, secure, and welcoming environment for events, staff, and visitors.

144L - Senior DevOps Engineer (AWS/EKS/Terraform/CI/CD) · Remote · LATAM

Get to Know Darwoft

At Darwoft, we build custom software solutions and partner with international companies to create high-impact digital products.

We are a Latin American technology company with a people-first culture, strong professional standards, and a long-term partnership mindset. We work with distributed teams, complex technical challenges, and clients whose technology has a direct impact on their businesses and users.

About the Project

We are partnering with an innovative cybersecurity company developing a modern Identity Security and Identity Observability platform .

The product enables enterprise security teams to monitor identity activity, identify security gaps, detect suspicious behavior, and reduce identity-related risks across cloud, SaaS, network, and on-premise environments .

Its architecture relies heavily on distributed systems, real-time data processing, cloud-native infrastructure, advanced analytics, and an increasingly AI-driven security roadmap .

As the platform continues to scale, infrastructure reliability, automation, observability, security, and developer productivity are critical engineering priorities.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to design, automate, operate, and continuously improve the cloud infrastructure and deployment platform supporting a high-scale cybersecurity product.

You’ll work primarily with AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, Terraform, Docker, CI/CD, and observability technologies , partnering closely with Software Engineering, QA, Security, and IT teams.

This role goes beyond maintaining infrastructure. You’ll actively contribute to platform engineering , helping engineers ship software faster and more reliably while improving automation, security, operational visibility, scalability, and cloud cost efficiency.

You’ll have a high degree of ownership over production infrastructure and participate directly in architectural decisions, incident resolution, platform improvements, and DevOps best practices.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design, build, and operate highly available and scalable cloud infrastructure primarily on AWS .
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform .
  • Deploy, manage, scale, and troubleshoot workloads running on Kubernetes , particularly Amazon EKS .
  • Develop automation for infrastructure provisioning, environment configuration, and application deployment.
  • Build and maintain reliable CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI .
  • Improve deployment processes, release reliability, and developer experience across engineering teams.
  • Manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Design and improve observability across infrastructure and applications.
  • Implement monitoring, dashboards, alerts, and centralized logging using technologies such as:
    • Prometheus
    • Grafana
    • AWS CloudWatch
    • OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
    • ELK
  • Participate in production incident response, troubleshooting, mitigation, and root cause analysis .
  • Identify recurring operational issues and automate their resolution.
  • Implement AWS and Kubernetes security best practices.
  • Collaborate with Security teams to strengthen infrastructure security and support compliance initiatives.
  • Improve platform resilience, high availability, scalability, and disaster recovery capabilities.
  • Optimize AWS resource utilization and contribute to cloud cost optimization and FinOps initiatives .
  • Automate operating system and infrastructure configuration using Ansible or similar tools .
  • Develop operational tooling and automation using Python and Bash .
  • Collaborate with Engineering teams on platform architecture and deployment strategies.
  • Continuously evaluate new DevOps, cloud, Kubernetes, observability, and platform engineering technologies.

What You Bring

  • 5–8+ years of experience working in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or similar roles.
  • Strong hands-on production experience with AWS .
  • Strong experience managing Kubernetes clusters , ideally Amazon EKS .
  • Advanced experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong experience with Docker and containerized environments .
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with:
    • GitHub Actions
    • Jenkins
    • GitLab CI
    • or similar platforms
  • Strong Linux administration skills.
  • Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible .
  • Good scripting and automation capabilities with:
    • Python
    • Bash
  • Experience implementing observability using technologies such as:
    • Prometheus
    • Grafana
    • CloudWatch
    • OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
    • ELK
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts including:
    • VPCs
    • Subnets
    • Load Balancers
    • DNS
    • VPNs
    • Firewalls
    • Routing
    • Security Groups
  • Experience troubleshooting complex distributed systems and production environments.
  • Solid understanding of cloud security and infrastructure security best practices.
  • Experience supporting highly available, production-grade cloud environments.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with engineering, security, QA, and business stakeholders.
  • High degree of autonomy, ownership, and analytical problem-solving ability.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Core Technology Stack

You’ll work with technologies including:

  • AWS
  • Kubernetes / EKS
  • Docker
  • Terraform
  • Ansible
  • GitHub Actions
  • Jenkins
  • Linux
  • Python
  • Bash
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • CloudWatch
  • OpenSearch / Elasticsearch

Nice to Have

  • Experience with HashiCorp Nomad .
  • Experience with HashiCorp Consul .
  • Broader experience with the HashiCorp ecosystem.
  • Experience operating Kafka in production.
  • Experience supporting data infrastructure based on:
    • ClickHouse
    • Elasticsearch
    • MongoDB
    • Redis
  • Experience with distributed systems and high-volume data platforms.
  • Previous experience in cybersecurity, identity security, or security SaaS platforms .
  • Experience working with cloud security controls and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience with FinOps and cloud cost optimization .
  • Experience designing internal developer platforms or platform engineering capabilities.
  • Exposure to infrastructure supporting AI/ML or LLM-based applications .

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

  • Increasing infrastructure reliability and availability.
  • Reducing deployment friction and improving engineering velocity.
  • Increasing infrastructure automation and reducing manual operational work.
  • Improving observability and reducing mean time to detection and resolution.
  • Operating Kubernetes workloads reliably at scale.
  • Strengthening security throughout cloud infrastructure and deployment processes.
  • Improving AWS cost efficiency without compromising reliability.
  • Contributing reusable platform capabilities that allow engineering teams to move faster.
  • Continuously improving production readiness as the platform scales.
